title: 第十三章 恐怖如斯第十四章 天材地宝
content_zh:
而今正好是半月有余，宋风则是按照自己此前的烧炼方式，一点一点小心翼翼的拿着一根筷子在陶罐之中轻轻搅动着。
其气息与整个灶台相合，甚至灶台下火焰的燃烧浓烈程度，仿佛间都在宋风的掌控之中，好似得心应手的拿捏着火炉一样。
两个徒弟忙完了药房的事情。
如今一大一小两个人在呼吸吐纳，练习旧版吐纳之法的同时，也是认真的盯着宋风的一举一动。
老二一双小眼睛滴溜溜的直转看起来精明无比，上蹿下跳的还以为是真的学到了什么东西，但其实都是咋咋呼呼。
老大看起来文静但却是蹲在灶火前，双眼之中带着一丝思索的看着自家师父跟灶台之中的火焰。
像是这等炼药的场景不只是一次了，老二看着灵光其实就是傻大个什么都是咋咋呼呼的，但老大看了这么长时间却也发现了一些规律。
他发现自家师父搅动陶罐里面药材的时候似乎是有着时机的，而且每一次的呼吸吐纳都仿佛是以风箱在吹着火炉一样。
一呼一吸之间那火焰烧的旺旺的，甚至时缓时烈，刚开始看露不出什么，时间长了经过对比他便发现，这火焰与此前几次竟有惊人的相似。
那种灵活的感觉仿佛师父能掌控一样。
“……呼吸法真的能够练到这一步吗？”
看着师父轻易的呼吸吐纳，似乎将吐纳之法熔炼到了生活之中的一举一动之中。
原本他得需要耗下心神，才能真的专心才达成的那种不徐不缓的吐息境界，师父却轻易拿捏。
这差距委实有些太大了。
不修行见师父如井中蛙观天上月，真的修行这呼吸吐纳之法，才是真的一粒蜉蝣见青天，往日低调平和的师父竟如山一般深沉高远。
“好了，这罐药终于算是熬出来了。”
最后晃了晃灶台将里面的火焰缓缓收缩的宋风也是长长吐气，一口气又绵又长，甚至跟着他呼吸吐纳，勉强学上一二的老大差点把气都给差住了:
“咳咳咳咳……”
通过气机变化调和完里面的药效之后，宋风便看到宋诚那一副满脸通红，岔着气伤着肺腑的模样，随即轻轻在他胸前抚了抚身上有气机流动。
虽然并没有明确的力量进入到老大的身体之中，但轻轻抚摸间调整了气息流动后，却见到刚刚还岔气，伤着肺腑，胸口疼的老大转瞬间就没了那种剧烈的疼痛感。

“这……这这这……”
看着老爷子仅仅是用手一抚就让他缓过气来，宋诚看向宋风的双眼之中带着一丝丝的惊骇之色。
而就在宋风帮老大把气息调匀缓过劲来的时候，却见到老二宋志则是哈哈大笑，似乎是在嘲笑老大似的:
“老大，你这呼吸吐纳之法不是都修行十好几年了嘛，怎么如今还能犯了岔气这种小错误？”
看着观察了这么多次，甚至跟着老爷子身边被老爷子提点的老二仍然傻乎乎的，颇有一种傻狗熊一样的姿态，老大则是无奈的摇了摇头。
自家师弟这脑子看样子估计悬了。
同样都是修行那呼吸吐纳之法的，难道自己这傻二弟没有看到，自家师父所达成的那种惊人成就吗？
人家都说外行看热闹内行看门道，同为修行呼吸法的内行中人，现如今老二看了场真东西却就跟看热闹的似的。
这不妥妥的大傻瓜嘛！
另一边。
content_en:
Now it was just over half a month, and Song Feng followed his previous cooking method, carefully stirring the pot with a chopstick little by little.
Its aura is consistent with the entire stove, and even the intensity of the flames burning under the stove seems to be under Song Feng's control, as if he is holding the stove with ease.
The two apprentices finished their work in the pharmacy.
Now, two people, one large and one small, were breathing and breathing in. While practicing the old version of the breathing method, they were also carefully watching Song Feng's every move.
The second child's small eyes were rolling around, making him look extremely shrewd. He was jumping up and down, thinking he had really learned something, but in fact it was just babbling.
The boss looked quiet, but he was squatting in front of the stove fire, looking at his master and the flames in the stove with a trace of thought in his eyes.
This scene of refining medicine happened more than once. The second brother looked at Ling Guang and was actually a fool who kept talking about everything, but the boss noticed some patterns after watching it for so long.
He found that his master seemed to have good timing when stirring the medicinal materials in the clay pot, and every breath he took seemed to be like a bellows blowing on a stove.
The flame burned fiercely with every breath, even slowing down and burning fiercely at times. At first, nothing could be seen. However, after comparing it for a long time, he found that the flame was surprisingly similar to the previous times.
That kind of flexibility feels like Master is in control.
"...Can breathing techniques really be practiced to this extent?"
Watching Master breathe out easily, it seems that the method of breathing has been integrated into every move in life.
Originally, he had to spend his energy and concentrate to achieve the state of slow and steady breathing, but the master could control it easily.
This gap is really too big.
If you don't practice, seeing the Master is like a frog in a well looking at the moon in the sky. If you really practice the method of breathing and exhaling, you can really see the sky like a mayfly. The Master who used to be low-key and peaceful turns out to be as deep and high as a mountain.
"Okay, this pot of medicine is finally coming out."
Finally, Song Feng shook the stove and slowly contracted the flames inside. He also exhaled for a long time. His breath was long and long. He even followed his breathing and exhaling. The boss who barely learned a lesson almost lost his breath:
"Cough cough cough cough..."
After adjusting the effects of the medicine through changes in Qi, Song Feng saw Song Cheng's face was red, his breath hurting his lungs, and then he gently stroked his chest to see the Qi flowing through his body.
Although there was no clear force entering the boss's body, after adjusting the flow of breath with gentle caress, he saw that the boss who was still breathing, hurting his lungs, and having chest pain just now disappeared from the severe pain in an instant.
"This...this, this, this..."
Seeing that the old man could calm down with just a touch of his hand, Song Cheng looked at Song Feng with a hint of horror in his eyes.
And just when Song Feng was helping the boss to mix his breath and calm down, he saw the second child Song Zhi laughing loudly, as if he was laughing at the boss:
"Boss, haven't you been practicing the breathing method for more than ten years? How come you still make such a small mistake as breathing out?"
After observing him so many times, and even following the old man for advice, the second child still looked stupid, with a silly bear-like attitude, while the boss shook his head helplessly.
It seems that my junior brother is probably out of his mind.
They also practice the method of breathing and exhaling. Could it be that my stupid second brother didn't see the amazing achievements achieved by his master?
People say that laymen watch the excitement while professionals watch the show. We are both experts in practicing breathing techniques, but now the second brother is watching the real thing as if he is just watching the excitement.
What a stupid idiot!
other side.
